one_liner.zh: 本周加密独自走弱：BTC 窗口约 -3.2%、ETH 更深，传统偏稳而链路呈「加密偏独立」；趋势偏震荡、杠杆中性，实现波动中等但期权相对 RV 偏贵，美现货 BTC ETF 合计净流约 -6.79 亿美金（温和流出）。
one_liner.en: Crypto moved weaker on its own: BTC window ~-3.2%, ETH deeper, while TradFi stayed steadier—link reads crypto-idiosyncratic; choppy trend, neutral leverage, mid realized vol but options rich vs RV; US spot BTC ETF net ~-678.90M (mild outflow).

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 -6.79 亿美金

risk.zh: 中等波动叠加 IV 溢价与 OI 回撤并存，若拥挤再起或现货通道加力，震荡易被放大；清算峰已现但未标成双高主线；杠杆读法：盯拥挤线（费率路径+OI）与出清线（2026-10-08 峰是否双高、次日是否退烧）。
risk.en: Mid vol plus IV premium alongside OI pullback: any re-crowding or stronger spot-channel pressure can stretch the chop; a liquidation peak printed but is not framed as dual-high driver; Leverage read: crowding (funding path+OI) and flush (2026-10-08 peak dual-high? next-day cool-down?).

watch.zh: 盯 ETF 温和流出是否延续、IV-RV 溢价能否收窄，以及偏震荡是否仍拒绝趋势跟随。
watch.en: Watch whether mild ETF outflow persists, whether the IV–RV premium narrows, and whether chop keeps rejecting trend-following.

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏贵（IV 相对 RV 溢价）

compare.zh: BTC 约 -3.2%、ETH 约 -7.0%，明显弱于同期 ES 约 +1.1%、NQ 近乎持平与黄金约 +1.3%；美元与十年期小幅变动、VIX 回落，传统风险偏好并未同步塌陷，标签落在「加密偏独立」而非同跌共振。
compare.en: BTC ~-3.2% and ETH ~-7.0% lagged ES ~+1.1%, flat-ish NQ and gold ~+1.3%; mild DXY/US10Y moves and a softer VIX show TradFi risk appetite did not collapse in lockstep—label stays crypto-idiosyncratic, not joint selloff.

path.zh: 窗口以偏震荡为主：价格下台阶但未走出单边趋势标签，基准自 10-04 收盘至 10-11，回撤与来回交织，更像区间内消化而非趋势加速。
path.en: Path stayed chop-leaning: price stepped lower without earning a one-way trend tag; from 10-04 baseline close through 10-11, pullback mixed with two-way trade—range digestion more than trend acceleration.

leverage.zh:
标签：杠杆中性。
① 拥挤线（OI + 资金费率年化）：周初约 +8.19%/yr → 期末约 +0.64%/yr，租金全周降温；OI 周变约 -5.20%（97444 → 92374），库存周内回落，偏去杠杆。
② 出清线（OI + 清算）：主峰日 10-08（2026-10-08）；峰值约 4.35× 周内中位清算量；价格同日约 -1.9%；当日 OI 约 92998；但 OI 周高在 2026-10-07（约 95827），峰值日并非双高；峰值日 OI 较前一日下降，偏出清/去库存与清算同日。次日 2026-10-09：OI 自峰值日回落至约 92523、funding 年化约 +5.85%/yr、价格约 +1.1%。
③ 量旁证（永续成交额=活跃度）：周合计约 716.04 亿美金，环比约 -10.0%，活跃度中性；量侧用于核对热闹程度，不拆多空。
收句：拥挤线与出清线并读 → 峰值日并非 OI 周高（无「清算∥OI 双高」）、量旁证偏淡，共同支撑「杠杆中性」；禁止把清算/OI/funding 写成涨跌原因。
leverage.en:
Label: leverage_neutral.
① Crowding (OI + funding ann.): ~+8.19%/yr → ~+0.64%/yr — rent cooled over the week; OI week change ~-5.20% (97444 → 92374), inventory down on the week — lean deleveraging.
② Flush (OI + liquidations): peak day 2026-10-08; peak ~4.35× median liq qty; price that day ~-1.9%; OI that day ~92998; OI week-high was 2026-10-07 (~95827), not a dual-high peak day; OI down vs prior day — flush/de-stocking with liquidations. Next day 2026-10-09: OI eased to ~92523; funding ~+5.85%/yr; price ~+1.1%.
③ Volume side (perp turnover = activity): week sum ~71.60B, WoW ~-10.0%, activity normal; activity only, not long/short.
Close: crowding + flush lines → peak day ≠ OI week-high (no liq∥OI dual-high); funding rent up but OI inventory not building; volume side quieter — supports “leverage_neutral”; do not write liq/OI/funding as the cause of price.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎约 -6.79 亿美金（温和流出：2 入 3 出，单日最大流出约 -4.85 亿在 10-07，最大流入约 +1.19 亿在 10-06）；ETH 合计约 -5.42 亿、五日皆净出。并陈 Binance 口径现货成交额周合计约 82.13 亿美金、环比约 -12%，总量热闹度同步降温——只对照通道与换手，不把净流焊成涨跌原因。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETF aggregate net ~-678.90M (mild outflow: 2 in / 3 out; largest daily out ~-484.9M on 10-07, largest in ~+118.8M on 10-06); ETH net ~-542.20M with five outflow days. Alongside, spot exchange turnover ~8.21B on the week, WoW ~-12%—activity cooled in parallel. Channel and turnover only; no causal weld to the price path.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 82.13 亿美金，相对上完整周 -12.4%（活跃度「中性」；上周约 93.76 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-10-08（17.79 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 716.04 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 8.21B, vs prior full week -12.4% (activity “normal”; prior ~9.38B). Peak day 2026-10-08 (1.78B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (71.60B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 中等 RV 说明路径有波动但未极端；IV 明显高于 RV，意味着期权定价仍在为尾部或事件付费，偏贵时「卖波动」逻辑更常被讨论，却仍取决于拥挤与路径是否配合。
vol_teach.en: Mid RV means the path moved without extremes; IV well above RV means options still price tail/event risk. Richness often invites harvest talk, but only if crowding and path cooperate.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 27%，落在中等波动；期末 Deribit IV 约 37%，IV-RV 点差约 +10 个百分点，期权相对实现偏贵标签成立。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~27% ann. sits mid; end Deribit IV ~37%, IV–RV spread ~+10 pp—options rich versus realized holds.

vol_combo.zh: 中等实现 + 期权偏贵 + 杠杆中性：波动有「价格」但杠杆层未同步加码，组合更贴近震荡里的波动收割与均值回归，而非趋势杠杆放大。
vol_combo.en: Mid realized + rich options + neutral leverage: vol has a price tag while the leverage layer did not reload—closer to harvest/mean-reversion in chop than trend-levered extension.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格周线收负的同时 IV 仍高于 RV，显示下跌未自动「砸平」隐含溢价；ETH 端 IV 约 51% 对 RV 约 45%，溢价结构类似但实现更高一档。
vol_price_iv.en: Negative price week while IV stayed above RV—the decline did not automatically crush the implied premium; ETH IV ~51% vs RV ~45% shows a similar rich structure at a higher realized tier.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 窗口约 -3.1%，传统恐慌温度下降，与加密中等 RV、偏贵 IV 并陈，更衬托本周「加密偏独立」：传统波动降温并未映射成加密期权便宜。
vol_vix.en: VIX ~-3.1% cooled TradFi fear gauges; set beside crypto mid RV and rich IV, it sharpens the idiosyncratic read—softer equity vol did not translate into cheap crypto options.

what.zh: 美股隐含波动指数 VIX

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元走强时对风险资产偏逆风。
vs_crypto.en: Stronger USD is often a headwind for risk assets.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与币关系需看结构，不宜硬套。
vs_crypto.en: Link to crypto is structural—not mechanical.

tradfi_summary.zh: 美股括号内 ES 小涨、NQ 近平，黄金跟涨，美元微升、美债收益率约 -3.3 bp，VIX 回落；传统整体偏稳偏暖，与加密下跌带形成反差，支撑「加密偏独立」标签。
tradfi_summary.en: In the US Fri–Fri bracket ES edged up, NQ nearly flat, gold firmer, DXY slightly higher, US10Y ~-3.3 bp, VIX lower—TradFi steadier/warmer versus crypto’s down week, supporting the idiosyncratic label.

three_conclusions.zh: 加密本周明显偏独立：BTC/ETH 收负而 ES/黄金偏暖、VIX 回落，同跌叙事不成立。
three_conclusions.en: Crypto ran idiosyncratic: BTC/ETH negative while ES/gold firmer and VIX softer—no joint-risk-off story.

three_conclusions.zh: 结构是偏震荡 + 杠杆中性 + 中等 RV，但期权相对实现偏贵，价格跌了溢价仍在。
three_conclusions.en: Setup is chop + neutral leverage + mid RV, yet options stay rich vs realized—premium survived the down week.

three_conclusions.zh: 现货通道转温和流出（BTC 净约 -6.79 亿）且现货/永续成交额环比降温，与杠杆回撤并陈，值得下期对照是否延续。
three_conclusions.en: Spot channel flipped to mild outflow (BTC net ~-678.90M) with spot/perp turnover cooler WoW, parallel to OI pullback—worth checking persistence next week.

text.zh: BTC 美现货 ETF 合计净流是否仍停留在温和流出（或单日再现数亿级流出）。
text.en: Whether US spot BTC ETF aggregate net stays in mild-outflow territory (or reprints multi-hundred-million outflow days).

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周由上周净流入翻成约 -6.79 亿，通道姿态是最大标签切换之一，适合作为下期核对哨。

text.zh: IV-RV 点差是否仍维持约双位数溢价，或随中等 RV 路径收窄。
text.en: Whether the IV–RV spread holds a double-digit premium or narrows along the mid-RV path.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 期末溢价约 +10pp 且标签期权偏贵，是波动结构矛盾核心，可验证是否被市场「磨掉」。

text.zh: 偏震荡标签下，OI 与资金费率是否继续低温中性，不出现重新拥挤。
text.en: Under chop, whether OI and funding stay low-neutral without re-crowding.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周 OI 约 -5%、资金费率年化仅约 +0.64%，杠杆中性是路径约束；若升温则与本周叙事分叉。

matched.zh: 偏震荡 + 中等波动 + 杠杆中性，使均值回归更贴合来回路径；IV 相对 RV 溢价则给波动收割类思路留下结构匹配（解释匹配，非推荐）。
matched.en: Chop + mid vol + neutral leverage fits mean-reversion to two-way paths; IV rich vs RV structurally aligns with vol-harvest framing (match explanation, not a recommendation).

mismatched.zh: 趋势跟随与「偏震荡」、窗口收负且未标趋势强化相斥：缺少可持续方向与杠杆顺风，硬跟趋势易与标签打架。
mismatched.en: Trend-following clashes with chop_low and a negative window without trend reinforcement—no durable direction or leverage tailwind.

why.en: Trend label “chop_low” lacks a clear one-way trend condition.

note.zh: 旁注：实现波动高或清算偏尖——即便趋势环境在，路径也可能很颠/拥挤。
note.en: Note: high realized vol or liquidation spike — trend backdrop can still be a rough path.

why.en: Trend reads choppy/grind (chop_low); closer to range-bound than one-way trend.

why.en: IV rich vs RV (iv_rich) and realized vol not extreme-high — a backdrop often discussed for “premium harvesting” *environments*.
